# BEST Express Vietnam

> BEST Express Vietnam is a comprehensive logistics platform offering shipping services, rate calculations, and insurance coverage across Vietnam and China.

BEST Express Vietnam provides express shipping solutions connecting Vietnam with China and other markets. The platform features transparent pricing, weight calculation tools, and comprehensive insurance policies for reliable cross-border logistics.
